messages:
maya: Heads-up — experimenting with surfacing per-tenant SLO fallthrough policies in the console. small prototype PR live.
ben: Nice. What's the main UX ask here?
maya: We want two knobs: (1) fallthrough granularity (per-route / per-tenant / global) and (2) notify fallback order (email -> page -> slack) so engineering teams can opt for quieter defaults.
rachel: Are we changing the notify API shape? We already have notify_fallbacks array on SLOs.
maya: Proposal is additive: keep notify_fallbacks but add routing_policy.name and routing_policy.quota_key so console can show and edit. backend will accept both old and new shapes.
tom: Concern: telemetry spikes if we surface editable routing policies at route level for tenants with many routes.
anna: Agree. We should sample change events and debounce UI saves. Maybe a 30s coalesce and an async apply with status?
maya: Thinking: UI coalesce + server-side rate limiter per-tenant. also expose a "preview" that simulates fanout impact on last 24h traffic.
rachel: Preview sounds useful. Who owns the simulator? eng-sre or platform?
ben: Platform owns the preview API but SRE should vet models & assumptions.
tom: API nit: If we add routing_policy.quota_key, can we reuse existing quota service? We need a mapping from quota_key -> tenant pool id.
maya: yes reuse. Implementation plan: console sends quota_key string, platform validates against quota catalogue. If mismatch, validation error in UI.
anna: Rollout plan? I'd like a canary: opt-in per org first, then gradual.
maya: plan: 1) feature flag server-side, 2) console toggle per-team, 3) telemetry events: policy_edit, policy_apply_result, preview_estimate.
ben: Add audit trail too — who changed fallthrough and when. Legal asked.
maya: audit will be stored in existing change_logs table. small schema add for routing_policy blob.
rachel: What about noise? Lots of small edits could create alert storms if notify defaults changed.
anna: We should gate notify fallback edits to org-admins and add a dry-run preview that shows expected notify rate delta and estimated pager volume.
tom: Implementation detail: preview needs tokenized sampling of historical SLO hits and current notify subscription lists. Might be heavy.
maya: Agreed it's heavy. Proposal: preview runs asynchronously and caches results for 1 hour; UI shows cached or in-progress. Also add a cost-estimate metric to telemetry.
ben: Metrics to track during rollout: policy_edit_count, preview_requests, policy_apply_failures, notify_volume_delta_est (per-tenant). Add SLOs on apply latency.
maya: I'll open an RFC with API sketch. quick sketch: ```json
POST /api/v1/slo/{id}/routing_policy
{
  "routing_policy": {
    "name": "tenant-fallback-low-noise",
    "quota_key": "tenant:acme:low-noise",
    "notify_fallbacks": ["email","slack"],
    "granularity": "per-route"
  }
}
```
rachel: Looks good. ensure backward compatibility: GET should still return legacy notify_fallbacks top-level.
maya: yes, API will synthesize for read.
ben: One last ask — make the preview return both absolute and relative estimations and CI for uncertainty. Helps PM sell it.
maya: noted. I'll route RFC for review and add telemetry checklist. tagging @ben @rachel for API review.
deploy-bot: Reminder: feature-flag rollout template available at https://internal/ff-rollout — please follow canary steps. :robot_face:
ben: thanks — will take API PR after RFC.
anna: I'll draft the rollout playbook for eng-oncall (quiet windows, throttles, quick rollback).
maya: thanks team, will post RFC link shortly.
